supersedes.supersession_reason: Phase E5.A diagnosed Arm A initial oracle launch failure (PermissionError: Only the fixed guarded pytest worker may launch) caused by a Windows CPython audit hook platform divergence. On Windows, subprocess.Popen._execute_child formats argv into a command line string via subprocess.list2cmdline() before invoking sys.audit('subprocess.Popen', executable, args, cwd, env). The previous check list(args[1]) != list(self.subprocess_argv) converted the string into a list of characters, which never matched the list of argument strings. Phase E5 repaired WritePolicy.audit to handle both Windows string-form (via subprocess.list2cmdline) and POSIX sequence-form arguments, and added regression tests POPEN-01 through POPEN-06.
